svg.title: Wayseeker — what are you settling for?
svg.desc: Wayseeker prescription No. 3u1xmp. Under the question What are you settling for?, five habits are struck out in red, each replaced by a tool printed in blue: generic “delight” decks with no concrete reference → Neal.Fun; vague redesign chats → Impeccable; “add a little bounce” without a target → 60Fps; guessing funnel steps from memory → Mobbin; fighting export pipelines for agent-built slides → Magic Slide.
